name: TUI Tool
description: Run any terminal (TUI) program in a tile: lazygit, htop, a REPL… Each tool config sets the executable, arguments, working directory and init commands; in a flyout the program keeps running while the flyout is closed.

tiles.title: TUI Tool
tiles.description: Runs a terminal program (htop, lazygit, …) in its own pane or flyout.

workingDirectory.title: Working directory
workingDirectory.description: Absolute, or relative to the project (default: the project root)

initCommands.title: Init commands
initCommands.description: Typed into the shell before the program starts
